cases.title: The client asks to clip a show with no permission
cases.clientRequest: Can you clip the newest episode of The Joe Show from YouTube for my channel? I do not have permission, but everyone does it.
cases.reference: We can only cut footage you own, footage you have a licence for, or footage the creator's clip programme covers. Clipping The Joe Show without that would put your channel at risk of copyright claims and of losing the right to earn from it. If The Joe Show runs a clip programme, send us its link, or a licence from the rights holder, and we will start.
